inputs.name: hand over from Training Data Drift Check to Training Pipeline

output.level_0: The Training Data Drift Check fails randomly due to missing dependencies.
output.level_1: There is no connection between the Training Data Drift Check and the Training Pipeline.
output.level_2: A team member manually triggers the Training Pipeline after the Training Data Drift Check.
output.level_3: The Training Pipeline automatically starts when the Training Data Drift Check completes.
output.level_4: The Training Pipeline only starts if the Training Data Drift Check passes with approved data versions.
